title: Split the single-file overworld JSON into per-subsystem sources
body:
content/world/new_york_overworld.json (67,721 lines, 2.65MB) is at once world geometry, procedural population, the entire authored campaign scripting surface (opening_registration/oath/lead_source/preparation/relief_allocation/ally + campaign_service_rules), and the quest registry. Every content PR touches it, so any two lanes editing world data conflict in ONE file, and every process pays full parse + assertOverworldIntegrity on first world call.

Proposal: split the manifest into per-subsystem files (geometry+roads, procedural population, authored campaign scripting, quest registry) or per-region files, composed by loadOverworldManifest (src/world/source.ts:180) before the existing zod parse + integrity gauntlet, so the runtime contract and hashes stay unchanged while lanes stop colliding. The loader already deep-freezes and caches; only the read step changes. Migration must keep the world hash stable (or land with the receipt-aware re-pin workflow) and keep the registry bijection check intact (assertOverworldQuestSourceCoverage).

From the 2026-08-30 full audit ("How the Forge Turns", findings ledger P2).
